notes.title: Victory Heat Rally OUT NOW on Switch!
notes.content:
3...2...1... GO play VHR on the go with the Nintendo Switch version dropping right now!

[previewyoutube=UiA9gtldq9A;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're reading this, there's a VERY good chance you already know everything you need to know about Victory Heat Rally but just in case!...

Prove yourself in the hottest competition of them all, the VHRC! Choose your racar and prove you've got what it takes to hit the top step of the podium across a whole host of racing events in the VHRC to be named Champion! 

Victory Heat Rally is a retro-inspired arcade racer with gorgeous super scaler graphics and a banging soundtrack. Take to the streets, beaches, forests, air strips and more as you tour the world of VHR and race across tracks that will put your skills to the ultimate test!

Single-player or up to 4-player splitscreen, VHR gives you the chance to finally decide who's the best racer among your friends!

Here's a handy link to the Nintendo store if you fancy grabbing VHR on the go!

notes.title: Patch rolling out to VHR now!
notes.content:
Hello folks!

A patch is rolling out to Steam right now to address some issues, please see the patch notes below:

UI
UI elements layering incorrectly in the Championship menu have been fixed
Arcade GP menu no longer accepts input once the user has pressed "back" to go back to the main menu
Fixed transition back into Championship after selecting "no" when the option to continue from where you left off appears 
Gameplay
Time Attack best times now save properly
Audio
Audio balancing with the rival gate unlock sound and the unlock song have been fixed 

I also wanted to say a huge thank you to everyone who has reviewed the game on Steam so far, we recently hit the incredible "Overwhelmingly Positive" label for the game which has been incredibly heartening to see, from everyone at Skydevilpalm and Playtonic Friends. 

Thank you again for your incredible continued support and all of the constructive feedback we've recieved so far! Keep it coming! We'll have more news about future VHR stuff soooon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594060/Victory_Heat_Rally/

notes.title: VHR - Hotfix rolling out now!
notes.content:
Yo!

A small hotfix for some issues is rolling out right now!

Please see below:

- Versus CPU difficulty can now be properly adjusted
- The "Rally" series of achievements now correctly track the right progression stat
- Engine audio and driver voice clips have had their gain increased to better balance audio
- Win/Lose rival cutscenes now play correctly on the overworld map, accordingly
- Steam screenshots are now working correctly
- Japanese language text now wraps properly in cutscenes

We'll have more news on the next patch as soon as possible. Thanks for all of your feedback so far, please keep it coming as we look towards future updates :)

notes.title: Victory Heat Rally | Post-Launch Update
notes.content:
Sup folks!

First off, THANK YOU for the absolutely rocking reception you've given Victory Heat Rally so far. From everyone at Playtonic and Skydevilpalm, we've been so excited to see the positive reception! Please consider leaving a Steam review if you haven't already! 

The Dev and QA teams are hard at work cooking up the first patch for the game but in the meantime I wanted to share an update on things we're already aware of/investigating for the future. We'll share full patch notes for the upcoming patch when we're closer to hitting the big "SEND IT" button. 

Known bugs/issues:

- Clipping objects on various circuits
- Barrier collision lacking at certain locations
- Rival victory dialogue always playing when loading in to championship until defeated
- Various minor localisation issues

Community feedback topics we're collating and investigating:

- Audio balance
- Difficulty levels
- Clearer results screens

This list won't be complete, and will grow as necessary! Once we've got a sure date for the first update, I'll be back with full patch notes.

Once again, thank you for all of your excitement, support and constructive feedback so far. It's truly very appreciated!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594060/Victory_Heat_Rally/

notes.title: Playtonic Friends is coming to WASD! April 25-27
notes.content:
This is Playtonic Friends first physical appearance at WASD and we would love for you to come along and say hi! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40214109/45f4a71f713b79ec3cc380c4db5381dbef1790b4.jpg

We're bringing FOUR of our latest and greatest Indie bangers for you to get your hands on! First up?

ELSIE

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515570/Elsie/

Elsie is a technicolor, hyperkinetic, rogue-like action-platformer filled with procedurally generated levels, an army of robots to blast through, and a wide scope of items and weaponry to make each run as unique as possible. Master countless magitek weapons and abilities in order to survive.

Be the first to play a BRAND NEW DEMO exclusively in person at WASD! 

VICTORY HEAT RALLY

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594060/Victory_Heat_Rally/

An intense, retro arcade-style racer that embodies the spirit of classic 90's racing games. Experience high-speed action, vibrant retro aesthetics, and non-stop drifting thrills as you challenge friends-turned-rivals. Get ready for an exhilarating ride!

Always the fan favourite - head over to the booth and test your racing skills on the show floor, or check out the demo, on Steam now!

CorpoNation: The Sorting Process

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2159960/CorpoNation_The_Sorting_Process/

You have been tasked with sorting the Ringo CorpoNation's genetic samples. With the credits that you earn, you can shop, game and pay your bills on time. Rogue workers may try to entice you into betraying your beloved employer, but we know you'll give 110%.

Come and check out our newest release with over 90% Positive Reviews on Steam! CorpoNation is also coming to Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series X/S on May 9th, 2024!

Lil Gator Game

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586800/Lil_Gator_Game/

Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer. Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels!

Head over to the booth and show some love to everyone's favourite Lil Gator Gamer - also now available on Game Pass!

Our lovely Brand Managers Anni and Sophie and super friendly Community Manager Steve can't wait to say hi to you all!

notes.title: Victory Heat Rally Shakedown Demo Gold is here!
notes.content:
Hey Racers!

We know you’ve been waiting for more information about Victory Heat Rally and today we’re excited to drop a BRAND NEW demo for Steam’s Race Fest!


What’s new?


 Split screen for local co-op. Grab a friend and see who’ll become the track champion!
 A tutorial with the Chief. He’ll give you the low down on what’s what.
 Even more tracks that will test your mettle.
 Updated visuals
 More commentary from Sally on VHN
And more!


We'd love to hear your feedback in the forums, so if you have a moment after trying out the new demo, head on over to the forums.

Now go out there, Victory is just ahead! And don’t forget to wishlist Victory Heat Rally too.
